1.o: Tatsumi leaves his village in pursuit of wealth and success in the Imperial Capital. He attempts to join the army, however it isn't as easy as it seems. When all of the sudden, a large breasted woman shows up at the local bar and offers to help him get recruited.

2.o: Tatsumi is taken by the Night Raid. They realized his potential as an assassin and asks him to join, but Tatsumi is conflicted. Though after learning more about each of Night Raid's team members, he learns of their objectives to defeat evil and corruption and eventually decides to join.

3.o: The Night Raid's hideout is invaded by intruders! The assassin clan was able to drive out the enemy without a problem. Tatsumi experiences the true intensity of the Night Raid for the first time and he is thrilled.

4.o: The target this time is the capital's rumored phantom serial killer known only as Zank the Executioner. Just like the Night Raid, he is an Imperial Arms user as well.

5.o: Sheele, who has no particular role in the hideout is assigned as Tatsumi's trainer. She explains how and why she chose assassinating as her career. Tatsumi, who still doesn't have an Imperial Arm of his own, tests out the Imperial Arm taken from Zank.

6.o: Night Raid is tasked with the eradication of a drug trafficking organization within the Imperial City. Tatsumi and Leone head towards the red light district. The two learn of the horrific details of the organization and their rage is apparent. Meanwhile, Sheele and Mine go after the Tybil, former leader of the organization when they suddenly feel an alarming presence.

7.o: General Esdeath arrives at the capital and is brought to the Emperor to discuss annihilating Night Raid. The Emperor wants to reward her for her services but her request is somewhat surprising.

8.o: Tatsumi and Bulat stand before the Three. Among them is Bulat's former leader, Liver. The battle quickly turns into a one-on-one combat between Bulat versus Liver and Tatsumi versus Nyau.

9.o: Tatsumi inherits Bulat's Imperial Arms Incrusio after defeating the Three and vows to become even stronger. Mine's attitude towards Tatsumi seems to show a change after seeing his dedication during training... Meanwhile, General Esdeath receives news of the Three being defeated and in order to reinforce the army's strength she organizes a special police force of Imperial Arms users known only as the Jeagars.

10.o: Esdeath has taken Tatsumi after winning the combat tournament. And the reason being... love at first sight?! That being said Tatsumi has not only been forced to become Esdeath's lover but also an auxiliary member of the Jaegers. Tatsumi and Esdeath observe as the Jaegers raid the bandits' hideout; he witnesses how powerful the Jaegers truly are. All the while Tatsumi tries to find an opportunity to escape and return to the Night Raid's hideout...

11.o: Dr. Stylish discovered Night Raid's hideout as he followed Tatsumi. A battle quickly commenced between Night Raid and Dr. Stylish's fortified army who struck with a surprise attack. Tatsumi and Mine are enraged as they see Kakusan equipped with Sheele's Imperial Arms Extase. A fierce battle continues within the hideout when suddenly something came down from the Sky...

12.o: After dealing with Dr. Stylish's attack Night Raid leaves their base and hides in the mountains. After welcoming the newly joined member, Night Raid experienced a brief moment of peace, even amid training. Mine, who has been teased relentlessly Chelsea, the newcomer, tells Tatsumi and Lubbok that she wants revenge.

13.o: A new species of Danger Beasts have emerged and has been terrorizing the vicinity of the capital. Minister Onest has ordered Esdeath to seize and defeat them. Esdeath leads the Jaegers to go to deal with them. But something suspicious in the shadow is keeping an eye on their actions. Meanwhile, after Night Raid settles into their new hideout, they're also on the move to deal with the new Danger Beasts.

14.o: Tatsumi and Esdeath meet again by chance while exterminating Danger Beasts. Esdeath is pleasantly surprised at the unexpected reunion while Tatsumi is overwhelmed. Even while fully immersed in the joy of their reunion, Esdeath notices that a man's been watching them from the shadows.

15.o: A widely accepted religious organization among the civilians known as the Path of Peace is quickly gaining more followers. It is rumored that they will cause an armed uprising in an attempt to fight against the corrupt government.

16.o: In order to combat the Jaegars, Night Raid is separated into two groups. Tatsumi and Akame are to deal with Bols, Kurome, and her puppets. The battle proves to be difficult as Kurome's Imperial Arms Yatsufusa has the ability to freely control the dead.

17.o: After being cornered by Akame and Leone, Bols sets off an explosion and flees. While he is trying to get back to his comrades, he runs into a hurt girl who is crying. Meanwhile, Kurome's medicine starts wearing off and she starts remembering her days with Akame as well as their sad goodbye, while stumbling through the mountain. While leaning against a tree eating snacks, someone approaches her...

18.o: Borick is scheming to take over a religious faction, and Night Raid heads to Kyoroch, where that religion has its headquarters. The Jaegars also head to Kyoroch to act as bodyguards for Borick. Wave is worried about Kurome, who still hasn't healed from her wounds. Night Raid safely infiltrates Kyoroch, however they must now face Borick's own appointed guards, the Four Koukenji Rakshasa Demons.

19.o: Night Raid continues to work on their plan to assassinate Borick in Kyoroch. Tatsumi and Mine wander around the city, but then end up running into Seryu, who is responsible for Sheele's death. Mine decides to end things once and for all with her, while Tatsumi fights Suzuka from the Four Demons.

20.o: Kyoroch is freed because of Night Raid, which strengthens the Revolutionary Army's power. In this dire situation, Commander-in-chief Budoh and the minister's son, Shura, join the fight against Night Raid. Meanwhile, Night Raid infiltrates the capital yet again. Tatsumi and Lubbock go after Minister Onest in the palace by sneaking in with the help of one of the Revolutionary Army's spies.

21.o: In order to instill fear into the hearts of those among the Rebel Army, the capital has spread the word that Tatsumi will be executed publicly. Night Raid receives notice of this and intends to rescue him.

22.o: Following Tatsumi's capture, Night Raid successfully defeated Commander-in-Chief Budou but at the cost of Main and Susanoo's lives. The Revolutionary Army surrounds the capital as the civilians start to riot. Wave is confounded by what he sees as Ran calmly observes how everything unfolds. Meanwhile, Kurome senses that the end of her life is drawing near and seeks to settle things with her older sister once and for all.

23.o: The Revolution finally reaches its final phase; Night Raid is en route to assassinate Minister Onest, the root of the problem. All goes according to Najenda's plan as the Revolutionary Army successfully invades the city. Night Raid arrives at the Palace where the Emperor and Minister are located. Unlike the panicked Emperor, the Minister is composed and confident as they prepare to unleash their trump card. As the palace trembles, something appears from below...!

24.o: The empire's army has been defeated and all that remains is the empire's strongest, General Esdeath. Akame and her sword stand in Esdeath's way as she desires to continue breeding war. The two face one another. The final battle begins. What will the result bring forth? A new kingdom where the citizens can live in peace or will there be more bloodshed...?

15.t: Looking for Eun and His Wife

16.o: Eun and Park Soondeok try to escape the Damiwon. So decides that he must become King of Goryeo, which means he must make sacrifices.

17.o: 3rd Prince Wang Yo's mental and physical health continue to dwindle, and So takes advantage. Princess Hwangbo Yeonhwa and Queen Hwangbo come up with a new plan for the future of their family.

18.o: So is pressured to marry Yeonhwa. Queen Yoo falls ill upon hearing that 14th Prince Wang Jeong is being punished.

19.o: 13th Prince Wang Baeka is chosen to lead soldiers in pacifying the slaves of Hubaekje. Jeong reveals to So his plan to marry Hajin and take her away from the palace.

20.o: Hajin leaves the palace to live with Jeong, but her condition worsens. Will she and So reunite before it's too late?

To show their sincerity, Yu Ran agrees to source 300,000 sacks of grain in the south for the Youzhou army, while Jiu Su stays behind. Yu Ru must risk going to Yangzhou to cover the remaining 50,000 sacks of grain to fulfill her contractual agreement.

24.o: Yu Ru works with Ye Shi An to not only bankrupt Commissioner Wang’s bank but also to purchase enough of the remaining grain she promised for the Youzhou army. Little does she know, Luo Zi Shang is helping her behind the scenes. She decides to stay for a couple of more days to help save Ye Yun and Ye Shi An and take them away from Yangzhou.

25.o: After Ye Yun kills Commissioner Wang, she is reunited with Ye Shi An and Yu Ru. Together, they journey back to Youzhou, making it just in time as per her contractual agreement with Commissioner Fan. They hear that Luo Zi Shang is now the commission of Yangzhou and has spread rumors that he was the one who killed Commissioner Wang. Lord Liang and his army march towards Youzhou while the Youzhou army is at the Eastern Capital.

26.o: The Liang army of 100,000 is at Youzhou’s door. Jiu Si holds down the fort with 15,000 soldiers while Zhou Ye heads to the Eastern Capital to get reinforcements. Jiu Si does a great job keeping the Liang army at bay when Lord Liang realizes he is his nephew. Jiu Si doesn’t back down, but Commissioner Fan and General Zhou believe Lord Liang is purposefully trying to reduce the Youzhou forces in the Eastern Capital, so it won’t help Jiu Su.

27.o: Zhou Ye goes against his father’s orders to remain in the Eastern Capital as he is determined to save the people of Youzhou. Jiu Si meets his uncle and continues to bluff that Wangdu has enough armed forces to beat the Liang army. However, Master Zhao escapes from prison and informs Lord Liang that there are only 10,000 armed forces protecting Wangdu. Lord Liang decides to conquer Wangdu as quickly as possible. Jiu Su and Yu Ru come to terms with dying together.

28.o: When the battle seemed most bleak for Wangdu, Zhou Ye and Wan Qin arrived just in time to turn the tide. Jiu Si captures Lord Liang, and Commissioner Fan becomes the new Emperor. General Zhou finally understands Zhou Ye, while Jiu Si, Ye Shi An, and Shen Ming are all promoted for their valiant efforts in protecting Wangdu.

29.o: Zhou Ye finally gains the admiration and respect of his father. Jiu Si volunteers to investigate the ledgers to understand why there is no money in the treasury to build a dam for the Yellow River. The old officials create obstacles for him, but he has found friends willing to help him. Luo Zi Shang suddenly appears as Grand Tutor for Crown Prince Fan, who believes his father values Jiu Si more than him.

30.o: Princess Yun Shang has liked Jiu Su ever since she was a child. She invites Yu Ru to a banquet when she finds out Jiu Si is married to her. The Empress Dowager pressures Emperor Fan to arrange a marriage between Princess Yun Shang and Jiu Si. Shi An is upset to hear Ye Yun has been teaching Shen Ming how to write. Jiu Si’s uncle warns him of the danger to him and his loved ones if Jiu Si continues with the corruption investigation.

31.o: Jiu Si discovers where Sun He, Minister Liu’s subordinate, is hiding. He is able to get a confession from him and uses it to coerce Minister Liu to testify against all the corrupt officials. However, Jiu Si is framed for the death of Minister Liu and all the “evidence” points to him as the murderer. He is imprisoned and works with Yu Ru to find out who the real murderer is.

32.o: Yu Ru finds evidence, but in order to see the Emperor, she must endure finger-crushing punishment first. Jiu Su meets with the ill Emperor, who issues an edict to send the crown prince Fan back to Youzhou alone and exonerates Jiu Su. Crown Prince Fan is worried the truth will come out, but Luo Zi Shang comforts him by saying Jiu Si will be killed.

33.o: Yu Ru is at the mercy of the Empress Dowager and Princess Yun Shang. Jiu Su arrives to protect her, but rather than submit to the Empress Dowager, he defies her and is accused of trying to kill the Empress Dowager. The Emperor is at a loss for how to handle the situation, so Yu Ru makes the ultimate sacrifice.

34.o: As Jiu Si and Yu Ru’s family and friends struggle with the aftermath of her death, the Emperor reveals his true plan for the future of Da Xia. Crown Prince Fan is sent to Youzhou alone, and Luo Zi Shang is no longer his tutor. Jiang He pledges his allegiance to the Emperor and begins colluding with Luo Zi Shang. Jiu Si is on his way to completing the Yellow River dam with a wealthy business backing him.

35.o: The Emperor’s plan is going accordingly, with Jiu Si and his young friends all earning merits from the Emperor and for the country. Despite the efforts of corrupt officials to create obstacles for Jiu Si, he has finally completed the Yellow River dam with Yu Ru’s help behind the scenes. Yu Ru is beyond excited to finally reunite with Jiu Si. Luo Zi Shang leaves the capital, realizing he’s been deceived by Jiang He.

36.o: Now that the Yellow River dam is completed, Yu Ru gives Jiu Si the biggest surprise of his life. They rush back to the capital to meet with the emperor. Meanwhile, Luo Zi Shang has discovered Yu Ru is alive and is again manipulating the crown prince. After seeing his son for the first time after three years, the emperor realizes he is not fit to be the next Emperor, so he summons Gao Lan to return after sending him away.

37.o: Although the Emperor had plans to make Zhou Gao Lang his successor, Crown Prince Fan declared himself the Emperor when his father died. The head eunuch goes crazy due to poisoning, and Zhou Gao Lang is sent on a suicide mission to fight at the southern border. The supplies for his army are cut off by Luo Zi Shang. Yu Ru and Jiu Si head south to help him but are targeted by assassins.

38.o: Though General Zhou and his army are victorious and headed back to the capital, Luo Zi Shang issues a false edict, accusing the Zhou family of treason. The new Emperor is cowardly and foolishly attests to the false edict when pressed by Ye Shi An, who is immediately labeled as a rebel and is set to be executed. Luo Zi Shang lies in wait for Jiu Si to appear in the capital.

39.o: Luo Zi Shang makes his calculated move against the Emperor and confines him. Jiu Si and Yu Ru arrive to help him, but they are captured by Luo Zi Shang. Jiu Si challenges Zi Shang to a final game of chess where they recount each other's moves and then predict each other’s next moves. Zi Shang is surprised by Jiu Si’s final chess move, but Zi Shang has an unexpected countermove.

40.o: Feeling guilty for abandoning Luo Zi Shang and his mother, Jiang He decides to accompany Zi Shang, and together, they can reunite with Yi Shui as a family. Jiu Si convinces an angry Gao Lang to forgo vengeance and accept the previous Emperor’s edict to become the new Emperor. The ensuing era is one of peace and prosperity for the people of Da Xia.
